label: Closed grounding collections rooted, from WELL_FOUNDED_ACTUAL_GROUNDING_1 (inference)
rule: Well-founded induction on the actual concreta: a member of a rootless ground-closed collection would have all its grounds outside the collection by the induction hypothesis, hence be a root
meaning: Well-founded actual grounding implies the closed-collection condition, with no excluded middle. Registered as a strength order; the limit-grounder control makes it strict.
